description.value:
Japanese culture loves smallness. Just look at the tiny, intricately crafted netsuke sculptures or the bonsai trees that fit into flowerpots. Shingen, the smart-machine-pistol made by Arasaka, is a love letter to Japan's passion for miniatures. It's hard to believe that the Shingen's stopping power, magazine size and numerous technical features fit into such a small body.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Efficient Autosear, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine and deals 1d6 less damage (3d6). Using Autofire with this weapon expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear].

Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
